title: The Undertow of the coast road
author: Petra Eriksen
blurb: Jonah Ishikawa, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the demolition date arrives.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
